rank_certificate_digests.canonical_list_definition: Compact JSON, no trailing newline, of all control and cell rank records projected to scope, owner, tensor, exponent, cut, field, rank, certificate_digest and sorted by those keys.
rank_certificate_digests.independent_verifier_policy: Every producer certificate is format-checked; all declared ranks are independently recomputed with a separately structured right-pivot basis implementation. Verifier certificate bytes may differ and are not treated as equality witnesses.
